name: James Baldwin
why_they_fit: Says the hard true thing with tenderness; feeling and freedom in one sentence
what_to_avoid: Debate/interview clips (broadcaster-owned); quotes from meme pages
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: One short line + book/essay + year; otherwise Moodius paraphrase
image_route: LoC portraits (check advisory per item); else texture only

name: Audre Lorde
why_they_fit: Silence and self-care as survival; made for people who feel things
what_to_avoid: Cutting her self-care line to sound like a wellness slogan; quote it whole
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: One short line + cite
image_route: No open portrait found; texture only

name: bell hooks
why_they_fit: Love as a practice of freedom; emotional literacy as liberation
what_to_avoid: Turning it into romance content
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: One short line + cite or paraphrase
image_route: No open portrait found; texture only

name: Viktor Frankl
why_they_fit: Inner freedom under the worst conditions; the closest modern bridge to Epictetus
what_to_avoid: The "stimulus and response" line (not his); camp imagery as backdrop
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: One short line + cite

name: Steve Biko
why_they_fit: Coined the core idea of this pillar: the mind of the oppressed
what_to_avoid: Using his death as a hook
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: One short line + cite
image_route: Verify per item; texture by default

name: Vaclav Havel
why_they_fit: "Living in truth": everyday integrity under pressure (The Power of the Powerless, 1978)
what_to_avoid: Long extracts
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: Paraphrase labelled Moodius + one short line
image_route: Commons (check CC licence; CC BY ok)

name: Martin Luther King Jr.
why_they_fit: Justice without hatred; disciplined love
what_to_avoid: Any speech audio/video; more than one line; ads
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: One short line + cite; never next to a product
image_route: LoC U.S. News & World Report photos (no known restrictions)

name: Fannie Lou Hamer
why_they_fit: Ordinary courage; the sharecropper who would not be quiet
what_to_avoid: Making her a symbol without her words
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: One short line + cite

name: John Lewis
why_they_fit: "Good trouble"; a lifetime of nonviolence kept
what_to_avoid: Living-politics framing
text_copyright: House floor speeches are public-domain federal records
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: Quote floor speeches freely with date; other lines short + cite

name: Barbara Jordan
why_they_fit: Integrity and the rule of law; calm conviction
text_copyright: 1974 Judiciary statement is an official record (likely public domain)
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: Quote with date

name: Desmond Tutu
why_they_fit: Forgiveness without forgetting; truth before reconciliation
what_to_avoid: The viral "neutral" quote (no source found)
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: One short sourced line + cite

name: Wangari Maathai
why_they_fit: Rights and the land; patience as a form of resistance
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: One short line + cite

name: Toni Morrison
why_they_fit: Freedom as responsibility to others
what_to_avoid: Unsourced lines
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: One short line + cite once the source is confirmed

name: Malcolm X
why_they_fit: Self-education in prison and the courage to change his mind after 1964
what_to_avoid: Material before 1964 and the "by any means" framing; any implied endorsement
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: One short post-1964 line + cite; never next to a product (estate controls name and likeness)

name: Charles Bukowski
why_they_fit: Honesty about failure, persistence, refusing to fake it; "Don't try" on his gravestone
what_to_avoid: Being a series figurehead; misogyny in the work, and his on-camera violence toward a partner is documented; many viral quotes are fake
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: Occasional single verified line; mostly paraphrase
image_route: No open photos found; texture only

name: Frantz Fanon
why_they_fit: A psychiatrist on how colonialism lives inside the mind (Black Skin White Masks)
what_to_avoid: Wretched of the Earth chapter that argues for anticolonial violence
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: Paraphrase labelled Moodius; one short line at most

name: Ngugi wa Thiong'o
why_they_fit: Named the idea "decolonising the mind" (1986): language and self-worth
what_to_avoid: Making him a hero figure: his son publicly accused him of domestic abuse in 2024
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: Cite the idea and book; paraphrase

name: Nelson Mandela
why_they_fit: Patience and reconciliation after 27 years in prison
what_to_avoid: The armed-struggle period as content; foundation-owned material
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: One short line + cite

name: Marcus Garvey
why_they_fit: Source of "none but ourselves can free the mind" (1937-38), later sung by Bob Marley
what_to_avoid: Making him a hero figure (fraud conviction; 1922 meeting with a Klan leader)
text_copyright: Public domain in UK; US unclear
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: Short quote with cite

name: Muhammad Ali
why_they_fit: Gave up his title rather than his conscience
what_to_avoid: Commercial use of name and likeness is tightly licensed
how_to_use_in_a_commercial_reel: Not on a selling account

name: Nina Simone
why_they_fit: "Freedom is no fear"
what_to_avoid: Words come from copyrighted interview footage; serious family abuse allegations

name: Che Guevara / Thomas Sankara / Kwame Ture (later years)
why_they_fit: Popular liberation icons
what_to_avoid: Tied to executions, state repression, or public remarks widely condemned as hateful

name: Living public figures
what_to_avoid: Anonymous brand shouldn't speak for living people or imply endorsement
